title: White glow, second pass: steady (not pulsing) candidates, 6 s each
intro: About 2 minutes, hands off. Same setup as before: darker spot, camera close on your character. Number 1 is last time's pick (flashing) for comparison. Note the numbers that are white AND steady. Press End to start.

steps.text: 1 of 19: RimLightInteractGimmic  (no. 9 from last time: white but flashing). White? Steady or pulsing?
steps.each_frame:
if G_wg2 ~= 1 then G_wg2 = 1; G_wg2n = 'RimLightInteractGimmic'
local d = _G.DPC_dbg; local c = d and ((d.state.active and d.state.pawn_chara) or d.state.arisen_chara or d.R.real_player())
if c then pcall(d.R.glow_for, c, 'RimLightInteractGimmic', 6.0) end
end
